key.name: toggle-chat
key.summary: Shortcut that shows or hides the chat window

key.name: active-site
key.summary: Site shown in the chat window (id from lib/sites.js)

key.name: window-position
key.summary: Where the window opens: next to the pointer or centered

key.name: pinned
key.summary: Keep the window open when it loses focus

key.name: lens
key.summary: Shortcut that captures part of the screen and asks the AI about it

key.name: ask-selection
key.summary: Shortcut that asks the AI about the selected text (or the copied image)

key.name: screenshot-card
key.summary: After each screenshot, offer to ask Quick AI about it

key.name: translate-language
key.summary: Language to translate into (empty = system language)
